question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

A teacher should be assessed on the basis of his ability to interact well with the children and to handle their __issues promptly__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"queries"** means questions or inquiries, especially those made to seek information or clarification. (प्रश्न)

 
 
• **Example:** The students asked several queries about the upcoming exam schedule.
 
 
 
• The correct word for the given context is **"queries well"**, as it aligns with the teacher's role in resolving the students' doubts and questions effectively. (प्रश्नों का समाधान)
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher addressed the students' queries well during the interactive session.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Chapters slowly** (अध्याय धीरे-धीरे): Refers to covering topics or lessons at a slow pace.

 
 
• **Example:** The teacher taught the chapters slowly to ensure every student understood the concepts.
 
 
 
• **Solutions nicely** (समाधान अच्छे से): Refers to providing answers or resolutions in a polite or pleasing manner.
 
 
• **Example:** He explained the solutions nicely to make them easier to understand.
 
 
 
• **Parents respectfully** (माता-पिता का आदरपूर्वक): Refers to interacting with parents in a respectful and courteous manner.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher spoke to the parents respectfully during the parent-teacher meeting.
